changed_fields.applies_to: principal building located between a front and rear principal

applies_to.quote: .5 Any principal building located between a front and rear principal must have a minimum 6.0 m separation from each of the front and rear principals, or, in the case of through lots, from each opposing front principal, and a minimum 2.4 m separation from any other principals between it and a side lot line.
